title: Great product for the right kid but very poor customer service, hard to cancel.
text: Our little suitcase got crushed pretty quickly by mistake and there is no way to replace it or purchase a new one; customer service was 100% nonresponsive. Our kid wasn't into it AT ALL and it was very hard to cancel, took several tries and cost us a lot. If the kid was really into it, it would have been fine just because we never would have found out how hard it is to cancel. Product is reasonably cute.
label: negative
